title.zh: $3.55 Million in Unclaimed Bridge Funds Moved via EIP-7702
title.en: $3.55 Million in Unclaimed Bridge Funds Moved via EIP-7702

current_state.zh: About $3.55 million in unclaimed bridge funds were moved out via EIP-7702 account authorizations, which BlockSec says were formally valid but leave open whether the wallet owner knowingly approved the transfers.
